budget: Free public data and local CPU only; no paid infrastructure
baseline: ATLAS 6 artifacts and exact sources remain immutable; source-baseline.zip preserves historical code bytes

development.prior_exposure: ATLAS 6 validation and partial second-recording results are already known. They are regression cohorts, never fresh independent holdouts.

reserved_temporal_test.rule: Do not inspect test labels or compute outcomes until candidate and calibration are frozen. Exclude reference identities also present before 1020 s in strict identity evaluation.
reserved_temporal_test.limitation: Same camera/date; temporal generalization only, not independent location or weather validation. Existing full-video CV predictions were computed in v6, but this interval was not quantitatively scored.

perception_metrics: Point IDF1 at fixed 4 m gate
Matched position MAE and speed MAE with coverage

physical_acceptance.rule: All supported criteria must pass on a frozen holdout before claiming an accepted physical twin. Missing signal/paired trajectory evidence prevents acceptance. Do not weaken thresholds after outcomes.

conditioning: Separate reference-boundary diagnostic, CV end-to-end reconstruction, and observed-state replay. An observed-state replay is not independent physical prediction.
publication: Publish failures, source integrity, exact settings, runtime, coverage, and split provenance. No simulated intervention may be described as a field benefit.
